theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_ll_gradient_weak_star
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (C : ℝ≥0) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (ug : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith C u Ω → (∀ k, LipschitzOnWith C (ug k) Ω) → TendstoUniformlyOn ug u atTop Ω → ∀ c : Eucl n → Eucl n, IntegrableOn c Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ (ug k) w (c w)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ u w (c w)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
